test_vectors.coverage: Exact success key order, null and empty/string IDs, numeric zero and negative one, i64 extrema, 9007199254740993, quoted 001, streaming and JsonEncode parity.
Exact quote, backslash, newline, carriage return, tab, backspace, form feed, NUL and Unicode escaping; all 32 ASCII control characters round-trip through envelope helpers.
i32 extrema, canonical protocol errors, empty messages, omitted data versus explicit null, array data, exact error key order.
Null, booleans, negative zero, exponent numbers, strings, arrays, objects and retained surrounding JSON whitespace in result and error data.
Results, error data, structured content and schemas share canonical syntax codes and byte offsets.
Literal and Unicode-escaped duplicate keys at root and nested array/object depths fail with DuplicateObjectKey across all raw JSON boundaries.
Complete and partial encoder output followed by an error preserves code, source, offset, schema ID and field ID; encoder invoked once per operation.
Oversized nested writes and usize::MAX reservations fail with PayloadTooLarge; an early outer sink failure prevents invoking the result encoder.
Every insufficient byte limit for success and both error variants propagates the exact transport error and leaves only an expected output prefix; exact capacity succeeds.
Caller prefixes remain intact; malformed nested output is excluded from the streaming destination.
Tools disabled, listChanged false/true, configured alternate version, omitted instructions and explicit empty instructions.
Protocol version, implementation name/version and instructions escape controls and preserve Unicode.
Empty implementation fields, empty/duplicate protocol versions, listChanged without tools, unknown and case-mismatched selected versions.
Empty list, stable input order, exact raw schema whitespace, escaped and empty descriptions; endpoint codes are absent from wire output.
Invalid separators, empty components, leading digits, whitespace, NUL and Unicode identifiers; valid ASCII boundary names; duplicate versus case-distinct names.
Valid non-object JSON is TypeMismatch with precise leading-whitespace offsets.
A later duplicate schema key or invalid name returns an error instead of a partial list.
Empty content, empty text, multiple text entries, Unicode/control escaping and both execution outcomes; text-only output omits structuredContent.
Structured object output is validated once, retained verbatim, ordered before isError, and bounded including outer overhead; empty structured objects are allowed.
Response, listing and text payloads survive destruction of their source values.
Generated content beyond default request nesting and field counts remains valid within the explicit output byte budget.
65535 nested containers are accepted and 65536 yield DepthLimitExceeded.
Decoded request ID flows into initialization, discovery and execution response envelopes; isError true remains inside a successful result; malformed-request failure uses null ID.
Owned output vectors exercise exact capacity, one extra byte, zero and one-byte limits, and one byte below required capacity, including UTF-8 and escaping overhead.
